Item.Name: LIFE_SPAN_IND
Item.Hint: Enter life span indicator : 'H' - Hours, 'D' - Days, 'Y' - Years
Item.Label: Life Span Ind

Trigger.Name: VALIDATE_FIELD
Trigger.TriggerText:
BEGIN
 IF :valid_product_attributes.life_span_ind NOT IN ('H','D','Y') THEN
 show_error('5231');
 check_package_failure;
 END IF;
 if :life_span_ind is null then
 :life_span := null; 
 set_item_property('life_span',INSERT_ALLOWED,property_false);
 set_item_property('life_span',UPDATEABLE,property_false);
 else
 set_item_property('life_span',INSERT_ALLOWED,property_true);

 end if;
END;

ProgramUnit.Name: DUPLI_CHECK
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
/* This Procedure Checks Out Duplicate Records while entering...
 PRODUCT ATTRIBUTES 31-Jan-97 
*/
PROCEDURE dupli_check IS
 temp_v_product_type varchar2(5);
 temp_v_attrib_group varchar2(5);
 temp_v_attrib_code varchar2(10);
 temp_v_anticoagulant_code varchar2(1);
 temp_v_item_name varchar2(50);
 temp_c_rec_no VARCHAR2(5);
 BEGIN
 temp_v_product_type := :product_type;
 temp_v_attrib_group := :attrib_group;
 temp_v_attrib_code := :attrib_code;
 temp_v_item_name := :system.cursor_item;
 temp_c_rec_no := :system.trigger_record;
 go_record('1');
 WHILE :system.last_record = 'FALSE'
 LOOP
 IF temp_v_product_type = :product_type AND
 temp_v_attrib_group = :attrib_group AND
 temp_v_attrib_code = :attrib_code AND
 :system.trigger_record != temp_c_rec_no
--Check if the record No. is not the same as current record
--and then check if all the fields viz. product_type,attrib_group
--attrib_code and anticoagulant_code are same as fetched 
--into temporary variables
 THEN
 go_record(temp_c_rec_no);
 go_item(temp_v_item_name);
 show_error('0069');
 check_package_failure;
 END IF;
 down;
 END LOOP;
 go_record(temp_c_rec_no);
 go_item(temp_v_item_name);
 EXCEPTION
 when OTHERS then
 handle_error;
 check_package_failure;
 END;
